configurations.//: autoPort is off on purpose. `npm start` takes the port from PORT and tells the bridge that exact origin, so a port picked by something else starts a face that looks perfectly alive and can never reach the brain.
configurations.name: jarvis
configurations.//writes: Append "--", "--writes" here to let JARVIS act — click and type in Chrome, drive the phone, run shell. Left off by default so a fresh clone starts read-only, as the README promises.
